tei:div.tei:p: dang po/ ༄༅/ /gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ / sngon 'gro'i zhu tshig....................... 1-5 bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/.................... 1-4 gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/..................... 1-3 ka1 spyi 'grel bstan pa/.....................( 2) ka2 gzhung don bshad pa/....................( 6) kha1 rtag 'dzin spong thabs bstan pa/..............( 7) kha2 bde 'dzin spang ba'i thabs bshad pa/...........( 19) kha3 gtsang 'dzin phyin ci log spang ba'i thabs bshad pa/....( 31) kha4 bdag tu 'dzin pa spang ba'i thabs bshad pa/.......( 43) kha5 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bshad pa/..........( 55) kha6 nyon mongs spang ba'i thabs bshad pa/...........( 69) kha7 nyon mongs skye ba'i yul la zhen pa dgag pa/........( 82) kha8 yongs su sbyong ba'i thabs bshad pa/............( 88) kha9 dngos po rtag pa dgag pa/................( 100) kha10 bdag dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/............( 110) kha11 dus dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/............( 119) kha12 lta ba dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/............( 128) kha13 dbang po dang don dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/.....( 140) kha14 mthar 'dzin dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/........( 150) kha15 'dus byas dgag pa sgom pa bshad pa/.........( 158) kha16 slob dpon dang slob ma gtan la dbab pa/.......( 167) ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/.................( 176) gnyis pa/ ༄༅/ /gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i stong thun bzhugs so/ / ka1 grub mtha' smra ba spyir bshad pa/.............(178)ka2 phyi nang gi grub mtha' so sor bshad pa/.........(179)kha1 phyi rol ba'i grub mtha' bshad pa/............( 179 )kha2 nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa/......( 181) ga1 bye brag smra ba'i grub mtha' bshad pa/..........(

182) ga2 mdo sde ba'i lugs bshad pa/..............( 186) ga3 sems tsam pa'i lugs bshad pa/............( 189) ga4 dbu ma pa'i lugs bshad pa/..............( 200) nga1 dbu ma pa'i lugs spyir bshad pa/............( 200) nga2 dbu ma thal rang gnyis so sor bshad pa/........( 207) ca1 dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs bshad pa/..........( 207) ca2 dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs bshad pa/.........( 210) ka3 mjug mthar phyin pa'i don bstan pa/..........( 349) gsum pa/ ༄༅/ /dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel ba rgyal mtshan bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so/ / ka1 spyi 'grel bshad pa/...................( 351) ka2 dkyus kyi don bshad pa/.................(354)kha1 mtshan don dang 'gyur phyag bshad pa/...........(354)kha2 gzhung gi don bshad pa/.................( 354) ga1 mchod par brjod pa/...................( 354) ga2 bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa/..........( 357) sa dang po/ rab tu dga' ba bshad pa/.............( 358) sa gnyis pa/ dri ma med pa bshad pa/..............( 365) sa gsum pa/ 'od byed pa bshad pa/..............( 369) sa bzhi ba/ 'od 'phro ba bshad pa/...............( 374) sa lnga ba/ sbyang dka' ba bshad pa/...............( 375) sa drug pa/ mngon du gyur pa bshad pa/.............( 375) ca1 shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi bsngags pa brjod pa/......( 377) cha1 zab mo'i don bshad par dam bca' ba/.........( 377) cha2 zab mo'i don bshad pa'i snod ngos bzung ba/.......( 378) cha3 de la bshad pas yon tan 'byung tshul bshad pa/.....( 378) cha4 snod ldan gyi gang zag la nyan par bskul ba/.......( 379) cha5 rten 'byung gi de nyid bshad pa/..............( 379) ja1 chos kyi bdag med rigs pas sgrub pa/..........( 379) ja2 gang zag gi bdag med rigs pas sgrub pa/.......( 421) sa bdun pa/ ring du song ba bshad pa/.............(
